title: Adaptation
hook: The offer that crushed it last year isn't guaranteed to work this year. Markets move on.
statement: Systems have to keep evolving or they fall behind.
explainer: The market changes whether you do or not. If it's moving faster than you are, you're losing ground even when nothing feels broken yet.
sop: List 3 strategies, offers, or habits unchanged for 6+ months.
Score your Adaptation Speed and the market's Change Speed 1 to 10 for each.
Flag anything where Change Speed beats Adaptation Speed.
Update the flagged ones this month, before they break.
equation_example: Adaptation Speed 6, Change Speed 8. 6 ÷ 8 = 0.75. Above 1 means you're adapting faster than the market moves, so you gain ground. Below 1 means the world is outpacing you and you're quietly falling behind.
question: Write down one thing you still do because it worked last year and check if it still does.
closing_statement: What worked last year isn't proof for this year.
caption:
Principle Nº 128: Adaptation

The offer that crushed it last year isn't guaranteed to work this year. Markets move on.

Systems have to keep evolving or they fall behind.

Your turn: Write down one thing you still do because it worked last year and check if it still does.
